capabilities: Create a Todoist project from the current note, named after the file
Create a Todoist task in the Inbox from the current line
Insert deeplinks connecting the note and the Todoist item
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create Todoist tasks or projects or to navigate between notes and Todoist items.

relations.evidence: Thanks to obsidian-things-link for providing the initial idea and the basic code

summary: Todoist integration that creates Todoist tasks and projects from notes and inserts deeplinks between them.
